1.w: Paul, an apostle of Christ Jesus by the will of God, according to the promise of life that [is] in Christ Jesus,

2.w: To Timothy, [my] beloved child: Grace, mercy, [and] peace from God the Father and Christ Jesus our Lord.

3.w: I have gratitude to God, whom I serve from the forefathers with a pure conscience, as I have unceasing remembrance of you in my prayers night and day,

4.w: longing to see you, recalling your tears, so that I may be filled with joy,

5.w: having taken remembrance of the unfeigned faith in you, which dwelt first in your grandmother Lois and in your mother Eunice, and I am persuaded that [it is] in you also.

6.w: Because of this reason, I remind you to rekindle the gift of God, which is in you through the laying on of my hands.

7.w: For God did not give us a spirit of timidity, but of power and love and soundness of mind.

8.w: Therefore you should not be ashamed of the testimony of our Lord, nor of me, His prisoner; but suffer together for the gospel according to the power of God,

9.w: the One having saved us and having called [us] with a holy calling, not according to our works but according to His own purpose and grace, having been given to us in Christ Jesus before times eternal,

10.w: and now having been made manifest through the appearing of our Savior Christ Jesus, having indeed abolished death and having brought to light life and immortality through the gospel,

11.w: to which I was appointed a preacher and an apostle and a teacher.

12.w: Because of this reason I also suffer these things. But I am not ashamed, for I know whom I have believed, and I am persuaded that He is able to guard my deposit entrusted for that day.

13.w: Hold the pattern of sound words, which you heard from me, in the faith and love that [are] in Christ Jesus.

14.w: Guard the good deposit entrusted by the Holy Spirit, the One dwelling in us.

15.w: You know this, that all those in Asia turned away from me, of whom are Phygelus and Hermogenes.

16.w: May the Lord give mercy to the household of Onesiphorus, because he refreshed me often, and he was not ashamed of my chain.

17.w: But being in Rome, he earnestly sought me and found [me].

18.w: May the Lord give to him to find mercy from the Lord in that day! And you know very well how much he served in Ephesus.
